title: Karambit safety ring / Vòng ngón Karambit
content: A Karambit has a concave hawkbill blade and a safety ring at the pommel; the source identifies the ring as a critical finger-hole detail.
constraints: Preserve the safety-ring opening as a distinct anatomical feature.

title: Knife pommel / Chuôi cuối dao
content: The technical mapping lists pommel as a knife-handle component with CylinderGeometry, metalness 1.0, and roughness 0.35.
constraints: Treat the pommel as a distinct handle component when the reference shows it.

title: Balisong pivot pin / Chốt xoay Balisong
content: A Balisong uses two handles with pivot pins, stop pin, and latch; the pivot pin is the rotation axis.
constraints: Model the pivot as the rotation axis rather than a decorative centered pin.

title: Weapon attachment socket / Ổ cắm gắn kết vũ khí
content: Use a named socket or contact region to describe a child attachment; the CS2 distill identifies threaded barrels as a suppressor-attachment case.
constraints: Record the parent socket and contact type for an attached child part.

title: CS2 finish roughness / Độ thô bề mặt CS2
content: The mapping gives anodized finish roughness 0.05–0.15 and anodized-multicolored roughness 0.05–0.10.
constraints: Use the documented finish range instead of inventing a scalar.

title: Edge wear / Mòn cạnh viền
content: Edge wear is damage concentrated along sharp corners or high-exposure edges; the mapping distinguishes it from general wear and tear.
constraints: Place wear by its described spatial distribution rather than uniformly.

title: CS2 float wear ranges / Dải float mài mòn CS2
content: The local CS2 vocabulary defines float ranges from Factory New 0.00–0.07 through Battle-Scarred 0.45–1.00.
constraints: Use the recorded ranges as terminology support, not as a claim about an unseen item's exact wear.

title: CS2 paint pattern UV projection / Chiếu UV mẫu sơn CS2
content: The CS2 vocabulary defines a paint pattern as a 2D texture projected onto 3D via UV and a wear overlay as texture adding damage based on float.
constraints: Keep paint-pattern placement and wear-overlay behavior tied to UV-backed source terminology.
